settings.title: Face & visible signals
settings.text: We capture what shows on your skin — congestion, marks, texture, dryness, reactivity — so the report starts from evidence, not guesswork.

settings.title: Habits & routine history
settings.text: What you cleanse with, what you skip, what already failed. The report notes patterns so a dermatologist does not start from zero.

settings.title: Lifestyle & climate context
settings.text: Sleep, stress, sun time, water, and where you live. These pressures change what “gentle” and “enough” mean for your skin.

settings.title: A report you can share
settings.text: One clear summary for product recommendations — and a structured brief you can pass to a Project Skin dermatologist.

settings.title: For you
settings.text: Understand what your skin is signalling before you buy another product.

settings.title: For recommendations
settings.text: Match cleanse, treat, moisturise, protect to the mechanisms in your report.

settings.title: For your dermatologist
settings.text: Bring a written brief into consultation — history, habits, and priorities already captured.

settings.title: For follow-through
settings.text: Use the same report to track what changed after you adjust the routine.

settings.question: What do you capture in the analysis?
settings.answer: Visible facial signals, your current habits and products, lifestyle factors, and climate context — enough to build a structured skin brief, not a vague quiz score.

settings.question: Is this a medical diagnosis?
settings.answer: No. It is a literacy and intake report that organises what you see and how you live. Clinical decisions stay with a qualified dermatologist.

settings.question: Can I share the report in a consultation?
settings.answer: Yes. That is one of its jobs — so your appointment starts with context, not a blank form.

settings.question: Will this recommend products?
settings.answer: The report points to mechanisms and a clearer sequence. Product suggestions follow from that — not from trend lists.

settings.heading: A skin report built from your face, habits, and life.
settings.text: We capture what your skin shows, how you care for it, and the lifestyle around it — then turn that into a comprehensive report for recommendations and, when you want, your dermatologist.
settings.body_heading: What we take into the report
settings.body_text: Analysis is intake with intent. Face signals, habits, and lifestyle land in one place — so the next step is clearer whether you shop, consult, or both.
settings.split_text: Read it yourself for literacy. Use it to guide a four-step sequence. Share it with a dermatologist so the conversation starts with your real context — not a cold open.
settings.cards_text: Same brief. Different decisions — personal, product, or clinical.
settings.faq_text: Short answers about scope, privacy of purpose, and what the report is for.
settings.cta_text: Start the analysis, then decide whether you need products, a routine finder, or a dermatologist conversation.
